en.answer: Even in this case, because <<12197>> was sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the Graveyard, its second effect can be activated.
en.question: If <<5350>> is activated, sending a Set <<12197>> to the Graveyard, can the second effect of <<12197>> be activated?
